# einvoice-at

> Self-hostable Austrian e-invoicing platform (Java 25, Spring Boot 4.1, PostgreSQL): generate, validate and convert ebInterface 6.1 and Peppol BIS Billing 3.0 (UBL) invoices, with human-readable German validation reports. Apache-2.0. Live demo: https://einvoice.sebastiankern.net

Not a Peppol access point, no automatic upload to e-rechnung.gv.at, no bookkeeping or tax (docs/PRD.md §5).

## Start here

- [README](https://github.com/Stoicera/einvoice_at/blob/main/README.md): what it does, quickstart, REST API, validation pipeline, deployment
- [Live demo](https://einvoice.sebastiankern.net/validator): public validator, no account needed
- [API docs (OpenAPI)](https://einvoice.sebastiankern.net/v3/api-docs): machine-readable API description of the demo
- [Problem types](https://github.com/Stoicera/einvoice_at/blob/main/docs/problems.md): every RFC 9457 error slug the API returns

## Design

- [Product requirements](https://github.com/Stoicera/einvoice_at/blob/main/docs/PRD.md): scope and non-goals

- [Glossary](https://github.com/Stoicera/einvoice_at/blob/main/docs/glossary.md): ebInterface, EN 16931, Peppol terms

## Examples

- [Samples](https://github.com/Stoicera/einvoice_at/tree/main/samples): one synthetic B2G invoice as canonical JSON, ebInterface XML and UBL XML
- [Golden-file corpus](https://github.com/Stoicera/einvoice_at/tree/main/validation/src/test/resources/corpus): valid and deliberately broken documents, one defect per file
